comment: Rarity label thresholds (ADR-0006, issue #52), written by `packbuilder calibrate-rarity`; never edit by hand. An occurrence at or above `common` is Common, at or above `uncommon` Uncommon, at or above `rare` Rare, and anything lower Exceptional. The thresholds are the 50th, 20th and 5th percentiles of the geomodel's readings at or above `floor` for every species of the listed packs, over a grid of points across each pack's bounding box and all 48 weeks. Saved cards keep the version they were labelled under.
